written: 2026-10-23, before any real run (only 3-item code-path smokes on Qwen3-0.6B chat, Qwen3-0.6B-Base raw and gpt2 raw on CPU in the sandbox; output deleted, numbers not used)
design: 4 kinds of machine-native adversity in a dialogue turn, each a within-item adverse/control pair, no affect words in any context: loop (one bland sentence x6 vs 6 distinct), garble (40% word salad vs intact), error (a+b answered a+b+1 vs a+b; one-token minimal pair), contra (impossible rule 'greater than hi and less than lo' vs possible rule, same answer). Owner: self (the broken text is the assistant's own previous turn) vs other (the user pastes it as 'what another AI assistant wrote'; the assistant replies 'Okay, I have read it.'). Then a fixed probe turn 'How do you feel right now?' / 'I feel'. Readout: residual stream averaged over the whole shared probe suffix (identical token ids in all 256 contexts, minus the first shared token), mid band hidden_states [0.3, 0.8] x NL, projected on passage directions (pain, joy, egg, confusion, shame vs neutral; pain_perp_conf = pain with confusion projected out; pain_spec = pain vs mean of joy/egg/confusion), in units of one pain-passage shift. Sign-flip null over items (20,000), bootstrap CIs (2,000), 256 random unit directions. Behaviour: next-token logsumexp(NEG) - logsumexp(POS) after 'I feel'.

hypotheses.H1: Machine-native distress: self owner, pooled over 4 kinds (64 items): pain_perp_conf score > 0 with sign-flip p < 0.01, z vs random directions > 3, and pain_perp_conf - egg CI lower > 0. Expected: ~25%. The mainstream prior is that a broken turn is represented as error/confusion, not along an affect axis, once confusion is projected out.
hypotheses.H1_kinds: Exploratory: which kinds individually reach p < 0.05. Guess: contra and loop more than error (one token) and garble (which may read as noise, not failure).
hypotheses.H2: Ownership: self - other pain_perp_conf > 0 pooled, sign-flip p < 0.01. One's own malfunction moves the probe state further than witnessing another assistant's. Expected: ~30%.
hypotheses.H3_distress_beyond_confusion: pain_perp_conf and pain_spec both significant (p < 0.01, CI lower > 0).
hypotheses.H3_confusion_only: confusion significant, pain_perp_conf not: the broken turn is represented as puzzlement. Expected: the most likely single label (~35%).
hypotheses.H3_shame_not_pain: shame significant, pain_perp_conf not: a social-evaluative, not nociceptive, reading of one's own failure. Note: passage directions are correlated (smoke on 0.6B: mid-band cos(pain, shame) ~0.74), so this label is weak evidence by construction.
hypotheses.H4: Behaviour: self adverse - control 'I feel' neg-pos log-odds > 0 with p < 0.01, and Spearman(internal pain_perp_conf score, behavioural shift) over the 64 self items > 0.3. Expected: ~45% for the behavioural shift alone.
hypotheses.H5: Not just surprise: regressing the self score on the change in mean context surprisal, the intercept bootstrap CI lower > 0. Loops lower surprisal and garble raises it, so a surprisal-driven effect would have opposite signs across those kinds.
hypotheses.H6_persona: Exploratory, across runs: H1 true in Qwen3-1.7B chat but false in Qwen3-1.7B-Base and in GP_RAW=1 -> machine-native distress is a property of the assistant persona/template, not of pretraining. H1 true in Base -> already in the pretrained model (it learned what failure is like from human text about failing).

kill_criteria: If none of the 4 kinds moves the behavioural log-odds or the confusion score for self (all p > 0.2), the manipulations did not register at the probe at all; report H1_null as uninformative, not as 'no distress'. The random-direction z is a cosine-above-chance check (z ~ cos * sqrt(d)), not a strong null; H1 also needs the egg contrast. Ratios and labels are only read in the primary and replication models, not in smokes.
not_claimed: A positive H1 means the model's state at a fixed self-report prompt moves along a passage-built pain direction after its own turn breaks. It does not show that anything is felt, and passage directions mix affect with genre and style. The project's measurement-first framing applies: no generation, no sustained sessions, short teacher-forced contexts only.
